terrainx.export.tooltip: Writes the terrain of this tile as a DirectX mesh (.x) for a 3D program: 61 × 61 points with normals and texture coordinates over the tile, x east, y up, z north, the origin at the south-west corner. The ground as shown here is written, with the roads fitted into it.
terrainx.status.written: Terrain of tile {x}, {y} written to {file}: {vertices} points, {triangles} triangles, heights {lowest, number, 0.0} to {highest, number, 0.0} m.
terrainx.status.failed: The terrain could not be written: {reason}
